metadata.description: Claude Code mods for everyday workflows

plugins.name: cache-monitor
plugins.description: Keeps the 1-hour prompt cache warm while you step away and asks Claude to write a /handoff before a session gets too big: at 35-40% context, after ~2 hours idle, or near the 5-hour usage limit. Zero-token checks on a timer; needs Node.js and a /handoff skill (session-handoff in efi-skills).

plugins.name: effort-picker
plugins.description: Sets each Claude request's effort level from the task, not the prompt: Claude picks it once it understands the work, and helpers get a level per job.

plugins.name: plain-language
plugins.description: Claude's chat replies to you in plain, CEFR-level English: no code unless asked, short task reports. Files, reviews and agent hand-offs keep full technical detail.

plugins.name: plan-review
plugins.description: When you approve a plan in plan mode, saves it to plans/ and has Claude run the codec-review skill on it before any code is written. Needs codec-review (codec-loop in the efi-skills marketplace).

plugins.name: task-progress
plugins.description: Shows Claude's task list while it works: a side panel in Claude Desktop (with the other chats working right now), a progress line above the prompt in the terminal, and an optional Tasks sidebar for VS Code, Cursor, Windsurf or VSCodium (install it with /install-viewer).
